  # Gatherer Reforged

  **The legendary 2005 *Gatherer* addon by Norganna (last updated in 2017) — finally reforged for modern World of Warcraft!**

  [![Code Quality](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/actions/workflows/quality.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/actions/workflows/quality.yml)
  [![Release](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/actions/workflows/release.yml)
  [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/gOOvER/GathererReforged?include_prereleases&label=Version&color=brightgreen&logo=github)](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/releases/latest)
  [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-Gatherer%20Reforged-f16436?logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/gatherer-reforged)
  [![Wago.io](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wago.io-Gatherer%20Reforged-c1272d?logo=wagtail&logoColor=white)](https://addons.wago.io/addons/ZKbqYR61)
  [![WoW Versions](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW-Retail%20%7C%20MoP%20%7C%20Cata%20%7C%20Wrath%20%7C%20TBC%20%7C%20Classic%20%7C%20Forever-f8b700?logo=battle.net&logoColor=white)](#-supported-wow-versions)
  [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPLv3-blue.svg)](https://github.com/WoW-Addons-Reforged/GathererReforged/blob/main/LICENSE)
  [![Support](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support-donate.goover.dev-ff69b4?logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://donate.goover.dev/)

---

Every long-time World of Warcraft veteran remembers **Norganna's legendary *Gatherer***—one of WoW's original and most iconic addons, first created back in **2005 (Vanilla WoW)** and maintained by *Norganna's AddOns* until its last official release in **September 2017 (*Legion* Patch 7.3)**.

After **more than 20 years** since its birth in Vanilla and nearly a decade without an official update, **Gatherer Reforged** brings this classic back from the ashes! Completely modernized and rebuilt from the ground up with a native **`C_Map` mapping engine**, a modern **Ace3 configuration interface**, a **redesigned Dark-Gold Report & Search UI**, a **Cross-Addon Live Sharing Bridge**, and the iconic **3D Heads-Up Display (HUD)** integrated directly into the core addon, it tracks your **Herbalism**, **Mining**, **Treasure**, **Fishing**, **Gas Cloud**, and **Archaeology** nodes across **Retail (*The War Within* / *Midnight*)**, **WoW Forever**, and all **Classic** flavors.

---

## ✨ Key Features

- 🏛️ **The Classic Legend, Rebuilt for Modern WoW**: Preserves everything old-school WoW players loved about Norganna's *Gatherer* (per-node harvest history, drop percentages, guild/party node sync, and the 3D HUD) while stripping out all broken legacy libraries (`Astrolabe`, `Babylonian`, `DongleStub`, `SlideBar`, `!Swatter`).
- 🧭 **Integrated 3D Heads-Up Display (HUD)**: The famous *Gatherer HUD* plugin is now built right into the main addon—projecting a customizable 3D compass overlay in the center of your screen with distance, angle, pitch, heat-trail tracking, and automatic hide conditions (combat, flying, mounted, inside instances).
- 🌿 **Comprehensive Node Tracking**: Automatically records exact coordinates, harvest counts, drop rates, inspection times, and sources for **Herbs**, **Mining Veins**, **Treasure Chests / Containers**, **Fishing Schools**, **Engineering Gas Clouds**, and **Archaeology** dig finds.
- 💰 **Live Session & Gold-per-Hour (GPH) Tracker**: Tracks nodes gathered, nodes/hour, total session loot value, and **Gold per Hour (GPH)** in real time—displayed in your **LDB DataSource bar** (*Titan Panel*, *Bazooka*, *ElvUI DataTexts*), the Minimap button tooltip, the Report sidebar, and Ace3 Options.
- ⏱️ **Respawn Cooldown Dimming**: Recently harvested nodes are automatically dimmed on the Minimap and 3D HUD for a configurable respawn duration (default 5 minutes) so you always know which nodes on your farming route are still on cooldown.
- 🔮 **Dynamic "Forever" Node Discovery**: Automatically learns and persists brand-new or custom herbs, ores, and treasures in current and future expansions or custom realms (such as *WoW Forever*) without waiting for static database updates.
- 🗺️ **Native `C_Map` Engine**: Built directly on Blizzard's modern `C_Map` and `C_Minimap` APIs with full support for zone, continent, and world-level node projection.
- 🖥️ **Modern Dark-Gold Gatherables Report & Node Density Search UI**:
  - Sleek `1px`-bordered dark-gold interface (`Gatherer.UIStyle`) with live search, filter pills, and **1-click profession category tabs** (*All, Herbs, Mining, Treasures, Archaeology*).
  - **Sortable columns** (`Node`, `Zone`, `Coordinates`, `Distance`, `Live Market Value`, `Source`) and **visual density progress bars** in the Zone Density Search window.
  - **Left-Click** a row to mark/unmark for batch transfer or deletion; **Right-Click** (or `Shift+Click`) any row to set a **TomTom or Blizzard Map Waypoint** directly to that node.

---

## 🌉 Cross-Addon Live Node Sharing Bridge

Guilds and raid groups often use a mix of different gathering addons. **Gatherer Reforged** includes a built-in **Cross-Addon Sharing Bridge** that automatically **receives AND broadcasts** newly discovered nodes across all major gathering addon protocols in Guild, Party, Raid, and Instance channels (with intelligent self-echo suppression including multi-word character surnames):

| Addon / Protocol | Prefix | Direction | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gatherer Reforged & Classic Gatherer** | `GathX` / `Gatherer` | bidirectional (`⇄`) | Native Gatherer protocol, enhanced to automatically register dynamic/custom nodes across clients, plus whisper mass-sharing. |
| **Gatherer Reborn** | `GRBNode` | bidirectional (`⇄`) | Full support for *Gatherer Reborn*'s tab-delimited live sync (`1\t<zone>\t<nodeType>\t<coords>\t<nodeID>`) + local `GathererReborn*DB` import & live sync. |
| **GatherMate_Sharing / GatherMate2_Sharing** | `GM2SD` / `GMSD` | bidirectional (`⇄`) | Exact protocol match (`A:<zone>:<dbIndex 1..7>:<coord>:<nodeID>`), acting as a modern replacement for the discontinued *GatherMate_Sharing* addon. |
| **GatherLite** | `GATHERLITE` / `G2G` | receive (`←`) | Decodes both `AceSerializer-3.0` and delimited node broadcasts from *GatherLite* users. |
| **Local `GatherMate2` & `Gatherer Reborn`** | Local API Hook | bidirectional (`⇄`) | Two-way live sync (`AddNodeChecked` / `InjectNode2` & `AddNode` hook) when running alongside a local *GatherMate2* or *Gatherer Reborn* installation. |

---

## 🧩 Full Map, Economy & UI Addon Compatibility

Gatherer Reforged works seamlessly alongside modern UI, map, and farming addons:

- **1-Click `GatherMate2`, `GatherMate2_Data` & `Gatherer Reborn` Importer**: Built-in importer (`/gather import`, in the *Integrations & DB* options tab, or directly inside the *Gatherables Report*) to import your saved `GatherMate2` / `GathererReborn` databases and pre-populated Wowhead databases from `GatherMate2_Data` & `GatherMate2Storage_*` (*Classic*, *TBC*, *Wrath*, *Dragonflight*, *The War Within*, *Midnight*, and *WoW Forever*).
- **Auctionator, TradeSkillMaster (TSM), OribosExchange & RECrystallize**: Displays live Auction House market values per herb/ore directly inside World Map / Minimap node tooltips and in the *Gatherables Report* table.
- **Routes & FarmHud**: Registers `GathererReforged` as a native data source in **Routes** (for automated TSP farming circuits) and automatically reparents Minimap pins when **FarmHud** is toggled.
- **OpenMap**: Full support for OpenMap's stitched world map (`OpenMapAPI` cross-zone projection, `ArtTopLevel()` layering, live pan/zoom rescaling, and native Show-menu toggles for *Gatherer Nodes*, *Herbs*, *Mining*, and *Treasures*).
- **MapWise**: Full support for MapWise's custom **Terrain** and **Paper** rendering modes (`MapWiseAPI`), continent/Azeroth projections, and automatic integration into MapWise's **"Addons"** toolbar menu.
- **Factionizer**: Native integration so **Factionizer** can display Gatherer Reforged node locations and counts for reputation-relevant herbs/ores.
- **ElvUI**: Native support for **Square** and **Round** minimaps (`GetMinimapShape()`), click-passthrough for ElvUI's right-click tracking & middle-click micro menus, and scaled World Map support.
- **Leatrix Maps / SexyMap / BasicMinimap / Chinchilla**: Dynamic frame layering above map reveal overlays and full support for all custom minimap shapes (`SQUARE`, `ROUND`, `CORNER-*`, `SIDE-*`, `TRICORNER-*`).
- **TomTom & Native Waypoints**: `Shift + Right-Click` or `Alt + Left-Click` any Gatherer pin on the World Map (or `Right-Click` any row in the Gatherables Report) to create a **TomTom** waypoint or native Blizzard map pin.
- **LibDBIcon-1.0, LibDataBroker-1.1 & Addon Compartment**: Works with LDB bars (*Bazooka*, *Titan Panel*, *ElvUI DataTexts*), *ElvUI WindTools* button bars, and Retail's Minimap Addon Compartment.

---

## 🎮 Supported WoW Versions

- **WoW Forever** (`16001`)
- **Retail / Midnight** (`12.x`)
- **Mists of Pandaria Classic** (`5.5.x`)
- **Cataclysm Classic** (`4.4.x`) & **Wrath Classic** (`3.4.x` / `3.8.x`)
- **Burning Crusade Classic Anniversary** (`2.5.x`)
- **Classic Era** (`1.15.x`)

---

## ⌨️ Slash Commands

Use `/gather`, `/gatherer`, `/gathererreforged`, or `/greforged`:

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/gather` or `/gather options` | Open the Ace3 configuration window |
| `/gather report` | Open the Gatherables Report dialog |
| `/gather search` | Open the Node Density & Zone Search dialog |
| `/gather import` | Import `GatherMate2`, `GatherMate2_Data` & `Gatherer Reborn` databases |
| `/gather session` | Print current session statistics and Gold/Hour (GPH) |
| `/gather reset` | Reset current session statistics |
| `/gather on` / `/gather off` / `/gather toggle` | Enable, disable, or toggle Minimap tracking |
| `/gather dist <yards>` | Set maximum Minimap tracking distance |
| `/gather num <count>` | Set maximum number of Minimap notes displayed |
| `/gather herbs on\|off\|toggle` | Toggle Herbalism node display |
| `/gather mining on\|off\|toggle` | Toggle Mining node display |
| `/gather open on\|off\|toggle` | Toggle Treasure / Container node display |

---

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Feedback

Found a bug or have a feature request? Please report it on the **[GitHub Issue Tracker](https://github.com/gOOvER/GathererReforged/issues)** (please include your WoW client version, addon version, and any Lua errors if available).

# Changelog

All notable changes to **Gatherer Reforged** will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.1.0] - 2026-11-18

### Added
- **Zone Farm Route Solver & Gathering Session Tracker (`Core/GatherRoutes.lua`, `GUI/GatherRouteSession.lua`, `Core/GatherCommand.lua`, `GathererReforged.toc`)**: Added `/gather route` / `/gather session` to generate optimized zone farm loops (Nearest-Neighbor + 2-Opt) with WorldMap route lines, TomTom/Map waypoint stepping, and a live session tracker (nodes/hr, type breakdown, and looted item counts).

### Fixed
- **Fishing School Recording (`Core/GatherScanner.lua`)**: Fixed `processLoot()` rejecting fishing pool loot because `GetLootSourceInfo(1)` does not return a `GameObject-` GUID for `IsFishingLoot()`, added `lastPoolTip` fallback and `C_Spell.GetSpellInfo` support, preserved `lastPoolTip` across brief unit mouseovers, and expanded German fishing pool keywords (`trümmer`, `elementar`, `schlamm`, `ölig`).
- **Fishing School / Pool Recording & Live Bridge (`Core/GatherScanner.lua`, `Data/GatherNodes.lua`, `Core/GatherIntegrations.lua`)**:
  - Replaced the unconditional `IsFishingLoot()` early return in `processLoot()` so **Fishing Schools / Pools / Wreckage** are recorded with their exact coordinates, primary fish icon, and loot drops, while open-water fishing without a hovered pool continues to be ignored.
  - Added dedicated `FISHING_SPELLS` detection (including empty-target `UNIT_SPELLCAST_SENT` casts and fishing spell icons), `lastPoolTip` / `lastFishingCast` tracking across bobber hover/cast duration, multilingual pool keyword matching, and bobber-name filtering.
  - Added `allowDynamicOpen` support in `Gatherer.Nodes.RegisterDynamicNode` for verified fishing pools and live-bridged `"Fishing"` nodes from GatherMate2 / GatherRadar.
- **Dynamic Addon Version in Tooltip (`Core/GatherMain.lua`)**: Read `Gatherer.Var.Version` directly from `GathererReforged.toc` metadata (`C_AddOns.GetAddOnMetadata` / `GetAddOnMetadata`) instead of a hardcoded `"1.0.4"` string so the LDB tooltip always matches the `.toc` version.

## [1.0.5] - 2026-11-14

### Fixed
- **Packager `Interface-Wrath` / `Interface-Titan` & `Interface-Forever` Headers (`GathererReforged.toc`)**: Moved `38002` to `## Interface-Titan: 38002` and `16001` to `## Interface-Forever: 16001` so `BigWigsMods/packager@v2` validates all flavor `.toc` headers cleanly.

## [1.0.4] - 2026-11-14

### Added
- **Full `OpenMap` Integration (`Core/GatherMap.lua`, `GUI/GatherMapNotes.lua`, `Core/GatherIntegrations.lua`, `GathererReforged.toc`)**:
  - Added `OpenMapAPI.WorldFromMap` / `OpenMapAPI.MapFromWorld` projection in `PlaceIconOnWorldMap` so Gatherer nodes align seamlessly across OpenMap's stitched world view (including adjacent zones outside `[0, 1]`).
  - Added `OpenMapAPI.ArtTopLevel()` layering in `UpdateOverlayLayering` so Gatherer pins always render above OpenMap's stitched terrain art.
  - Registered `OpenMap_StitchedChanged` and `OpenMap_ViewChanged` callbacks plus **OpenMap** Show-menu toggles (`Gatherer Nodes`, `Herbs`, `Mining`, `Treasures`) via `OpenMapAPI.RegisterMenuToggle`.

### Fixed
- **OpenMap & WorldMap Canvas Zoom Pin Scaling (`GUI/GatherMapNotes.lua`)**: Hooked `WorldMapFrame.OnCanvasScaleChanged` in addition to `WorldMapFrame.ScrollContainer.OnCanvasScaleChanged` so map addons that zoom the canvas directly (such as **OpenMap**) trigger pin rescaling instead of leaving WorldMap nodes oversized.
- **Flavor TOC Interface Versions & `no-lib` Metadata (`GathererReforged.toc`, `.pkgmeta`, `Core/GatherMain.lua`)**:
  - Added all missing client interface numbers (`110207, 120000, 120001, 120005` in `## Interface-Retail:`, `16001` in `## Interface-Classic:`, and `38002` in `## Interface-Wrath:`) so generated flavor `.toc` files (`_Mainline.toc`, `_Vanilla.toc`, `_Wrath.toc`, etc.) include every supported client version and no longer trigger WoW's `"Incompatible"` warning.
  - Added `## X-Embeds: Ace3, LibSharedMedia-3.0, LibDBIcon-1.0, LibDataBroker-1.1, LibStub` alongside `## OptionalDeps:` and `#@no-lib-strip@` so both standard embedded packages and `-nolib` packages work seamlessly.

## [1.0.3] - 2026-11-08

### Fixed
- **Preserve `Gatherer.IsSafeString` & `Gatherer.IsSafeValue` (`Core/GatherObjects.lua`, `Core/GatherComm.lua`)**:
  - Preserved `Gatherer.IsSafeString` and `Gatherer.IsSafeValue` from `Core/GatherPolyfills.lua` when `Core/GatherObjects.lua` initializes the `Gatherer` table, and added a self-contained `isSafeStr` guard in `Core/GatherComm.lua`, fixing `GathererReforged/Core/GatherComm.lua:63: attempt to call a nil value`.
  - Normalized hyphens and spaces in `isSelfSender(who)` (`"Shyvin-Shy"` vs `"Shyvin Shy"`) so self-sent node broadcasts are reliably suppressed on realms with multi-word character names.

## [1.0.2] - 2026-11-08

### Fixed
- **Suppress Self-Echoed Node Broadcasts (`Core/GatherComm.lua`, `Core/GatherIntegrations.lua`)**:
  - Recorded outgoing `GathX`, `GRBNode`, `GM2SD`, and `GatherRadar` payloads (`lastSentMessage` / `lastExternalSent`) on send and enhanced `isSelfSender(who)` to strip `-Realm` suffixes (including realms with spaces) and match character surnames (e.g. `"Shyvin Shy"` on WoW Forever where `UnitName("player")` returns `"Shyvin"`), preventing the player's own gathered nodes from being echoed back as received guild/group nodes.

## [1.0.1] - 2026-11-08

### Added
- **Dynamic Price Source Selector**: Added a **Price Source** dropdown under *Integrations & DB* that dynamically lists only currently installed/loaded Auction House addons (**Auctioneer Reforged**, **Auctionator**, **TradeSkillMaster (TSM)**, **OribosExchange**, **RECrystallize**) alongside *Automatic* and *Vendor Sell Price Only*.
- **Enhanced Auctioneer Reforged Support**: Added fallback support for `Auc-Util-Appraiser` (`Appraiser.GetPrice`) and `Informant` (`Informant.GetItem`) vendor prices, and added `Auc-Advanced` and `Informant` to `OptionalDeps`.

### Changed
- Prioritized **Auctioneer Reforged** first when the price source is set to *Automatic*.

### Fixed
- **Accurate Node Recording Only on Interaction (`Core/GatherScanner.lua`)**:
  - Disabled automatic background Minimap radar node saving (`runMinimapRadarScan`) and premature `WorldFrame:OnMouseDown` recording that previously saved nodes while merely hovering, turning the camera, or clicking from a distance.
  - Nodes are now saved **only** when actually gathered (`LOOT_READY` / `LOOT_OPENED` right at the node) or when a right-click within interact range triggers a locked/skill-requirement message (`UI_ERROR_MESSAGE`).
- **Classic & Forever Profession Skill Detection (`Core/GatherUtil.lua`)**:
  - Updated `Gatherer.Util.GetSkills()` to check both modern `GetProfessions()` and Classic `GetNumSkillLines()` / `GetSkillLineInfo()`, preventing Herbalism/Mining from being treated as unlearned on hybrid clients.
- **Node Deduplication & Position Accuracy (`Core/GatherStorage.lua`)**:
  - Increased node merge radius to `20` yards (or `0.006` normalized zone coordinates) and ensured real harvests overwrite any previous unharvested `"REQUIRE"` coordinates instead of averaging with them.
  - Added automatic startup deduplication in `PurgeInvalidDynamicNodes()` to merge existing duplicate node trails in `GatherItems`.

### Added
- **Dynamic Price Source Selector**: Added a **Price Source** dropdown under *Integrations & DB* that dynamically lists only currently installed/loaded Auction House addons (**Auctioneer Reforged**, **Auctionator**, **TradeSkillMaster (TSM)**, **OribosExchange**, **RECrystallize**) alongside *Automatic* and *Vendor Sell Price Only*.
- **Enhanced Auctioneer Reforged Support**: Added fallback support for `Auc-Util-Appraiser` (`Appraiser.GetPrice`) and `Informant` (`Informant.GetItem`) vendor prices, and added `Auc-Advanced` and `Informant` to `OptionalDeps`.

### Changed
- Prioritized **Auctioneer Reforged** first when the price source is set to *Automatic*.

### Fixed
- **Accurate Node Recording Only on Interaction (`Core/GatherScanner.lua`)**:
  - Disabled automatic background Minimap radar node saving (`runMinimapRadarScan`) and premature `WorldFrame:OnMouseDown` recording that previously saved nodes while merely hovering, turning the camera, or clicking from a distance.
  - Nodes are now saved **only** when actually gathered (`LOOT_READY` / `LOOT_OPENED` right at the node) or when a right-click within interact range triggers a locked/skill-requirement message (`UI_ERROR_MESSAGE`).
- **Classic & Forever Profession Skill Detection (`Core/GatherUtil.lua`)**:
  - Updated `Gatherer.Util.GetSkills()` to check both modern `GetProfessions()` and Classic `GetNumSkillLines()` / `GetSkillLineInfo()`, preventing Herbalism/Mining from being treated as unlearned on hybrid clients.
- **Node Deduplication & Position Accuracy (`Core/GatherStorage.lua`)**:
  - Increased node merge radius to `20` yards (or `0.006` normalized zone coordinates) and ensured real harvests overwrite any previous unharvested `"REQUIRE"` coordinates instead of averaging with them.
  - Added automatic startup deduplication in `PurgeInvalidDynamicNodes()` to merge existing duplicate node trails in `GatherItems`.
- Fixed missing close button (`UI-StopButton`) and checkbox checkmark (`UI-CheckBox-Check`) icons in `GathererConfigFrame`, `GathererReportFrame`, and `GathererNodeSearchFrame` when running alongside `ElvUI` / `AddOnSkins` or custom UI fonts.
- **ElvUI Ace3 Skin Compatibility (`GUI/GatherReport.lua`, `GUI/GatherAceGUI.lua`)**: Cleared `callbackBackdropColor` and hid `iborder`/`oborder` in `UIStyle.ApplyBox`, hid `checkbg.backdrop` in `styleAceCheckBox`, and enforced left-aligned text on AceGUI `Dropdown` widgets when ElvUI's Ace3 skin is active.

## [1.0.0] - 2026-11-07

### Added
- **Cross-Addon Sharing Bridge**: Live node sharing and synchronization with **Gatherer Reborn** (`GRBNode`), **GatherMate2_Sharing** (`GM2SD`/`GMSD`), **GatherRadar** (`GatherRadar`), and **GatherLite** (`G2G`) across Guild, Party, Raid, and Instance channels.
- **Virtual Minimap Radar Scanner**: Coroutine-based Minimap radar (`Minimap:UpdateMouseoverAtPoint` + `C_TooltipInfo.GetMinimapMouseover`) that automatically detects and records tracked herbs, ores, treasures, and fishing pools from up to ~100 yards away, complete with skill-difficulty border rings and a live-radar glow indicator.
- **1-Click `GatherMate2` & `GatherMate2_Data` Importer**: Direct database import for saved `GatherMate2` / `GatherRadar` nodes and pre-populated Wowhead databases across all expansions (`/gatherer import`).
- **Live Market Values**: Displays current Auction House prices from **Auctionator**, **TradeSkillMaster (TSM)**, **OribosExchange**, **RECrystallize**, and **Auctioneer** in node tooltips and reports.
- **Session & Gold-per-Hour (GPH) Tracker**: Tracks session duration, nodes/hour, loot value, and GPH in the LDB feed, Minimap tooltip, and Report sidebar (`/gatherer session`, `/gatherer reset`).
- **Harvest Cooldown ("Respawn Timer")**: Automatically dims recently harvested nodes on the Minimap and 3D HUD for a configurable respawn duration.
- **Ecosystem Integrations**: Native support for **MapWise**, **Routes**, **FarmHud**, **ElvUI**, **Leatrix Maps**, and **TomTom** / Blizzard waypoints (`Shift+Right-Click` or `Alt+Left-Click` on World Map pins).
- **Modernized UI & Built-in 3D HUD**:
  - Redesigned **Gatherables Report** and **Node Density Search** windows with category tabs, instant search, sortable columns, and waypoint support.
  - Added live **UI Font Size (`10pt – 18pt`)** scaling (`A-` | `13pt` | `A+` header buttons in `GathererConfigFrame`, `GathererReportFrame`, and `GathererNodeSearchFrame`) with automatic button width calculation (`btn:UpdateSize()`) so localized labels never overflow.
  - Integrated **3D Heads-Up Display (HUD)** directly into the main AddOn.
  - **Ace3** options panel (`AceConfig-3.0` / `AceGUI-3.0`), **`LibDBIcon-1.0`**, **`LibDataBroker-1.1`**, and Blizzard **Addon Compartment** support.
- **Multi-Client & Dynamic Node Support**: Native `C_Map` mapping engine and automatic discovery of new herbs, ores, treasures, fishing schools, gas clouds, and archaeology nodes across **Retail (12.x)**, **Classic Progression**, **Classic Era**, and **WoW Forever (16001)**, including recording herbs and ores on click even without Herbalism or Mining learned.

### Changed
- Rebranded and modernized Norganna's classic *Gatherer* as **Gatherer Reforged** under **GPL-3.0** (upgraded from `GPL-2.0-or-later`).
- Migrated all 18 supported languages (`enUS`, `deDE`, `frFR`, `esES`, `esMX`, `itIT`, `ptBR`, `ptPT`, `ruRU`, `koKR`, `zhCN`, `zhTW`, `csCZ`, `daDK`, `elGR`, `nlNL`, `plPL`, `trTR`) to native **`AceLocale-3.0`** files with 100% translation coverage.
- Modernized node icon resolution using built-in FileDataIDs and item icon fallbacks to prevent missing textures across game flavors.
